rules.title: SQL / Command Injection
rules.assertion: Raw user input concatenated into a query string or shell exec without parameterization.

rules.title: Hardcoded Secrets & API Keys
rules.assertion: High-entropy strings matching API token signatures (AWS, Stripe, JWT secret) in source.

rules.title: Unvalidated JWT Header / Alg None
rules.assertion: JWT verification accepting `alg: none` or unverified signature payloads.

rules.title: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected/DOM)
rules.assertion: Unescaped dynamic rendering in HTML/JSX without sanitization.

rules.title: Permissive TLS Cipher / Insecure Protocol
rules.assertion: Ingress or client config accepting TLS 1.0/1.1 or plaintext HTTP fallbacks.

rules.title: The Dependency Rule Violation
rules.assertion: Inner Domain/UseCase module directly imports outer UI/Controller, ORM, or Framework.

rules.title: God Class / SRP Violation
rules.assertion: Single class or module handling both business logic, data persistence, and network presentation.

rules.title: Concretion Coupling over Abstraction
rules.assertion: High-level use case instantiates concrete infrastructure adapters instead of depending on abstractions/interfaces.

rules.title: Domain Entity Leakage across Boundary
rules.assertion: Internal enterprise domain entities exposed directly as external HTTP/API responses instead of simple DTOs.

rules.title: Null / Undefined Safety Gap
rules.assertion: Accessing properties on nullable objects without optional chaining (`?.`) or explicit guard.

rules.title: Unhandled Promise Rejection
rules.assertion: Asynchronous promise without `.catch()` or `try/catch` block causing unhandled crash.

rules.title: Boundary Value Omission (0, Empty, Max)
rules.assertion: Array indexing or division without bounds/empty check or integer overflow prevention.

rules.title: Missing Network / I/O Timeout
rules.assertion: External HTTP/RPC call initiated without timeout configuration or abort signal.

rules.title: N+1 Query in Loop
rules.assertion: Database query or ORM fetch executed sequentially inside an iteration loop.

rules.title: Unreleased Connection Handle
rules.assertion: Database connection or file descriptor acquired without guaranteed release in `finally` block.

rules.title: Detached Event Listener / Hook Leak
rules.assertion: Component event listener or subscription not unregistered during unmount lifecycle.

rules.title: Scope Creep / Bloated PR
rules.assertion: PR modifies > 500 lines across unrelated domain boundaries.

rules.title: Breaking API Contract Change
rules.assertion: Public method signature altered, removing required parameters without version deprecation.

rules.title: Missing Test Coverage for New Features
rules.assertion: Production code added without accompanying unit or integration test assertions.
